messages:
Alice M: Heads up — platform pushed a change to the internal proxy contract that makes X-Route-Policy required. Breaking SDKs that don't send it. Anyone see this in dev tests?
Ben K: saw it in canary, failing ~3% of requests for node/python clients.
Chris L: this was intended to help quota attribution + routing fallbacks. We thought SDKs would default it automatically.
Dana R: SDKs don’t have any notion of routing policy; we don’t want to bake product rules into client libs. Breaking change without a deprecation window :/
Alice M: not intended to be breaking — our deploy bot added a strict check if header missing. I can revert the strictness. Can we do a graceful compatibility path?
Eva S: fallback we discussed was server-side defaulting to "auto" and SDKs optionally emitting header.
Ben K: fallback causes telemetry noise — console dashboards then show a spike of "inferred" routes for a day. Hard to distinguish real traffic from fallback.
Chris L: proposal: server accepts missing header and sets an internal telemetry tag "_route_inferred":true instead of forcing the header. That keeps SDKs safe and preserves attribution.
Dana R: +1. Also SDKs should expose an explicit opt-in, something like: 
```json
{
  "routePolicy": "explicit" // or "auto"
}
```
so a team can opt into sending the header when they want deterministic routing.
Alice M: that sounds reasonable. Can we also add an introspection endpoint so SDKs can fetch per-account defaults instead of guessing?
Ben K: introspection adds extra RTTs and caching logic in SDKs. Prefer server inference + a short-lived telemetry flag that teams can filter on.
infra-bot: Deploy 2026-03-20T09:12:03Z started for internal-proxy v2
Eva S: ok, plan: revert the required/400 check, mark requests without header as "inferred" in telemetry, and add an SDK opt-in flag + docs. I'll open the issue and coordinate SDK PRs.
Dana R: please also add unit tests in SDKs for missing header and a changelog note. Feature flag + rollout window is important.
Alice M: filed INF-471: rollback + telemetry tag + SDK opt-in proposal — https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INF-471 :thumbsup:
Chris L: thanks. can we have a 15min sync tomorrow to cover rollout UX and prevent this class of breakages? This has come up a couple times.
Ben K: yep, putting on calendar.
Dana R: will add a short postmortem section to the agenda.
Alice M: thanks everyone.
